angle_en: The bright path of agni and uttarayan
angle_hi: अग्नि और उत्तरायण का तेज मार्ग

en.intro: Krishna has just spoken of the times when a yogi departs and returns, and now he names the very path that leads away from return.
en.notice: Listen to the list of light, agni, jyoti, daylight, the bright fortnight, and uttarayan, the northern course. These are not random times; they trace the bright path of the sun, the route through which the knower of Brahman departs.
en.next: Krishna then names the opposite path of smoke and night, the route that leads the departing soul back to earth.
en.meaning: Fire, daylight, the bright fortnight, and the six months of the northward course: those who depart then, knowing the supreme reality, go to the supreme reality.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी उन समयों की बात की थी जब योगी जाते हैं और लौटकर आते हैं, और अब वे उस मार्ग का नाम लेते हैं जो कभी लौटने नहीं देता।
hi.meaning: जिस मार्ग में अग्नि, ज्योति, दिन, शुक्ल पक्ष, और छह महीनोंवाले उत्तरायण का अधिपति देवता है, उस मार्ग से शरीर छोड़कर जानेवाले ब्रह्मवेत्ता पुरुष पहले ब्रह्मलोक को प्राप्त होकर बाद में ब्रह्मा जी के साथ ब्रह्म को प्राप्त हो जाते हैं।
hi.notice: इस मार्ग में अग्नि, ज्योति, दिन, शुक्ल पक्ष और उत्तरायण का क्रम एक साथ आता है। यह सूर्य की तेज रोशनी का वह मार्ग है जो ब्रह्म को जानने वाले को मुक्ति की ओर ले जाता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर धुआं, रात, कृष्ण पक्ष और दक्षिणायन के विपरीत मार्ग का नाम लेते हैं, जो जाने वाले को वापस पृथ्वी पर ले आता है।

en.intro: Krishna has just spoken of the times when a yogi departs and returns, and now he names the very path that leads away from return.
en.body: Fire, daylight, the bright fortnight, and the six months of the northward course: those who depart then, knowing the supreme reality, go to the supreme reality. Listen to the list of light, agni, jyoti, daylight, the bright fortnight, and uttarayan, the northern course. These are not random times; they trace the bright path of the sun, the route through which the knower of Brahman departs. Krishna then names the opposite path of smoke and night, the route that leads the departing soul back to earth.

issues: meaning_changed: "अधिपति देवता" (The Sanskrit source lists the deities (agni, jyoti, ahas, shukla, uttarayana) as the path itself, not as 'overlords' or 'deities' (अधिपति देवता) of the path. The Hindi translation adds a hierarchical relationship (अधिपति) that is not in the source. Additionally, it changes 'those who depart' (प्रयाताः जनाः) to 'those who leave the body' (शरीर छोड़कर), which is a specific action not explicitly stated in the source.)

meaning_changed: "ब्रह्माजीके साथ ब्रह्मको प्राप्त हो जाते हैं" (The source says 'go to the supreme reality' (ब्रह्म गच्छन्ति). The Hindi translation adds that they first attain Brahmaloka and then attain Brahman along with Brahmaji. This adds specific theological details (attaining Brahmaloka, going with Brahmaji) that are not present in the source text.)

contrast_template: "बल्कि यह सूर्य की तेज रोशनी का वह मार्ग है" (The Hindi notice uses the contrast word 'बल्कि' (but/rather than) to contrast the list of times with the 'bright path of the sun', implying the list is not just times but rather a path. This is an interpretive contrast not supported by the source.)
